notes.title: Hare Special Update!
notes.content:
For the past few months we've been hard at work updating everything in the game: Graphics, gameplay, music and more!

You can see it by comparing the two trailers for the game!

New!
[previewyoutube=Bfc7CZNmgG0;full][/previewyoutube]
Old
[previewyoutube=DO5udPsK3lo;full][/previewyoutube]


Ivan has changed, he is more detailed aswell as the worlds and the rest of the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30615909/759d7904a361bd95a213c010565ac7dabe3e0f92.jpg[/img]


Now Ivan has more skills! He can do a backflip, fly and auto accelerate! You can also fully deactivate the HUD!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30615909/ad591c69164c4e1ad601b41f8d04fe90b07e4034.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30615909/77e04b84ef1c73398c25b17ada876bbd36e364f5.jpg[/img]

We've changed some bosses, made more fun fighting to fight them! 

Aphrodite:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30615909/57317df3bc5c2d25350071ccb85b41fc3c8e8cd6.jpg[/img]

Eunomia:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30615909/21f672735627e5718b7575283fe1bc6cf3459884.jpg[/img]

We've integrated your highscore and speedruns with steam score system! Now you can globally compete with time and points!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30615909/5dcdedfbd9b7a0a00fbedb7c95fc6bb759da3e8c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30615909/9a5937308d49cf1a9d20f0d12cd3d8e84939e9d4.png[/img]

We hope that this update can bring more fun for you! A more complete, fun and arcade game!

notes.title: Update 23/10/2017
notes.content:
[h1]OST[/h1]
If you wanna hear Hare OST here is a link to the playlist of the ost:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N6m1_lVU0x8&list=PLYIR1kj4qAKRZxFGsXXGp2dnGjMSNsln_

[h1]Update 1.1[/h1]
[*] Seed for runs (It's not tested, but it should kinda work)
[*] Hardcore mode now has a timer for speedruns (And now you have 1 extra life because it was too hard)
[*] Camera improvements
[*] Checkpoints for adventure mode
[*] Skip Button for intro
[*] Ivan now is faster (Jumping makes him go faster and his overall speed limit is higher)
[*] Secret stuff
